notConfigured.heading: Team server not connected
notConfigured.body: This build has no Supabase configuration, so only personal features (chat, memory) are available. An admin needs to set VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY at build time.

signIn.heading: Sign in to work with your team
signIn.body: Sign in with your GitHub account. Your browser will open the sign-in page; come back to the app when done.

invites.heading: Invites
invites.byEmail: Email (empty = share code anyone can use for 7 days)
